notes: Burn It Out through Soul Immolation removes Regurgitate from the Devourer; Vengeful Retreat clears Paralyzing Shots, Regurgitate, or Toxic Atrophy only when the effect is removed through its snare classification.
Void Nova is an area stun and Imprison is a creature-limited control stop; neither is a spell-school interrupt.

Void Nova and Sigil of Misery stop susceptible dangerous channels such as Solar Breath; the guide lists no dungeon-specific purge or self-cleanse target. Solar Breath's current spell ID is omitted from the join until it enters the canonical ability catalog.
Consume Magic removes Healing Breeze and Soul Cleanse through Soul Immolation removes the listed curse from the Devourer.
Vengeful Retreat clears Frigid Roar from the Devourer; Void Nova and Imprison provide susceptibility-dependent stops.
Consume Magic removes Fel Crazed and Soul Cleanse removes Curse of Doom only from the Devourer.
Void Nova and Imprison stop susceptible Fel Missiles, Seduction, or Flay channels; Spectral Sight remains available but the Devourer guide does not assert the Havoc-specific Street Sneak use.
Vengeful Retreat removes Violent Sand or Gravitic Orbs slows from the Devourer.

Void Nova stops a susceptible Protective Turtle before Shell Guard completes; it is a stun rather than interrupt-school coverage. Melt Armor (1250043) is a player Magic debuff and is deliberately not modeled as a Consume Magic target.
Consume Magic removes Accumulate Charge; Void Nova stops susceptible Arrow Barrage and other dangerous channels.
Imprison only controls eligible Humanoids, Beasts, or Demons and does not apply to every Temple enemy. The Arrow Barrage spell ID is omitted until a current-build ID is independently corroborated.
Consume Magic removes Bound by Shadow, Captain's Bulwark, or Unholy Mending; Burn It Out and Soul Cleanse are self-only answers to Wretched Discharge and Hex Volley.
Vengeful Retreat clears eligible movement effects. Imprison is rated none because the relevant dungeon population is predominantly Undead.
Consume Magic removes Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier. Void Nova stops susceptible Ice Shield or Flaming Barrage channels.
Imprison is limited by the many Elemental and Dragonkin enemies and only applies to eligible Humanoid casters.

recommendations: Void Nova and Sigil of Misery handle clustered orbs; Disrupt and Consume Magic clean up separate misses.
No dedicated utility swap is required; use Devourer's strong priority damage on the emissary.
Use natural mobility to intercept partner orbs; no dedicated talent swap is required.
Vengeful Retreat removes the personal slow; Soul Immolation with Burn It Out or Soul Cleanse removes an eligible self shield.
